title: Sample Preparation for 3D-Raman Microspectroscopic Mapping of Protist Cells
author: Felix Weber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ztyf6pw

steps.title: Wash Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Perform a washing cycle on the formaldehyde-fixed sample to prepare it for mapping.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 150 rcf for 10 min
Remove the supernatant using a pipette
Resuspend the cell suspension with Volvic spring water via repipetting or gentle vortexing
Repeat these three actions three times total
Keep the cell suspension at 4°C on ice to increase water density and improve cell adhesion

steps.title: Prepare Microscope Stage
steps.instruction: Set up the sample holder and environment for Raman interrogation.

substeps.instruction: Place a cleaned stainless steel square in a petri dish
Fill the petri dish with Volvic water and place it on the microscope stage
Place two beakers containing water-saturated blotting paper inside the microspectrometer's dome to maintain 100% relative humidity

steps.title: Load Sample onto Slide
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell subsample onto the stainless steel slide.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve a 10-40 µl subsample from the cell suspension using a 100 µl micropipette
Insert the pipette tip into the petri dish until it touches the stainless steel slide
Delicately load the sample onto the slide while minimizing agitation

steps.title: Perform Raman Interrogation
steps.instruction: Acquire 3D Raman microspectroscopic maps of the cells.

substeps.instruction: Gently insert the water immersion 63x objective lens into the water until specimens on the stainless steel slide are visible
Start Raman interrogation of the whole cell of interest within a 3-D grid set at the desired spatial resolution
